summary: Two autotuned live inputs plus two loop voices, each on its own SC output channel; Python owns the mutation set.
notes: SC output channels are 0-based bus indices; Ableton input channels are 1-based.
Ableton tracks 1-4 are mono tracks; select BlackHole 16ch input 1, 2, 3, 4 respectively.
Loop 1 records MiniFuse 2 input 0; loop 2 records MiniFuse 2 input 1.
Optional loops 3/4 sum into SC 2/3 and are not part of the four-channel product.
Stage 5's 8-pair infrastructure map is separate and lives in config/ableton_routing.json.
No Aggregate Device is required for the primary path.
